items.title: A masterclass in pace mismanagement
items.summary: Hasan's workload tells the story in even starker terms. He bowled 47 overs against Afghanistan in Abu Dhabi, 14 against West Indies in Mirpur and 35 in Sylhet. By the third day at the Wanderers, he had added another 20 overs and four balls. That is 116 overs and four balls across four Tests in just 37 days, with his elbow problem already known to the team.

items.title: ‘We are still in the game,’ insists Taskin
items.summary: Only 28 overs were possible before rain and thunderstorms brought an early end to the day, but Bangladesh had made good use of the new ball to claim three quick wickets and wrest back some momentum.
